title: enrtlMultiSalt operation
description: Multi-salt symmetric eNRTL bench: the mean-ionic gammas of two (or more) salts sharing an ion, swept across the mixing fraction at constant total molality — the Harned-rule experiment. Two formulations run side by side by declaration: `published` (the industrial expressions exactly as printed) and `refined` (gamma as the EXACT Gibbs-Duhem-consistent derivative of the same excess Gibbs energy, the chain rule kept through the composition-dependent mixing rules). The difference between them is measured, not asserted.

salts.title: Salts
salts.description: `( { cation Na; anion Cl; } { cation K; anion Cl; } ... )` — each salt by its two ions; stoichiometry derives from the charges.

totalMolality.title: Total molality
totalMolality.description: Held constant while the salt fractions sweep; defaults to 4.0.

tauEE.title: Ion-ion tau
tauEE.description: The salt-salt interaction parameter; defaults to 0 (none fitted).

formulation.title: Gamma formulation
formulation.description: published (default) = the industrial expressions as printed; refined = the Gibbs-Duhem-exact derivative of the same G_ex.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — where the per-row results are written, relative to the case directory.
